g.text: I build clean, responsive web applications with practical
user flows, maintainable structure, and real-world focus.
I am a Computer Engineering student with a strong interest in web
development and software engineering. I enjoy building practical
projects that solve real needs, learning new technologies, and
continuously improving my skills. I focus on responsive interfaces,
clean code, robust APIs, and thoughtful database design.
Practical project experience with modern technologies
Real-world features and clear user flows
Open to collaboration and new opportunities

Program, built with TypeScript and a modern interface.

Clean design with practical sections and a smooth layout.
Advanced React components with hooks and state
Express APIs, middleware, and REST patterns

Thank you for visiting my profile!
Consistent learning and building real projects lead to real opportunities.
